localizedText.zh-CN: 提取HTML与Custom Elements Manifest文档
localizedText.en: Extract HTML and Custom Elements Manifest documentation

localizedText.zh-CN: 按明确配置或直接输入抽取HTML类文档并生成标准工件。
localizedText.en: Extract HTML-family documentation and generate standard artifacts from explicit configuration or direct inputs.

localizedText.zh-CN: htmdoc --config htmdoc.config.json
localizedText.en: htmdoc --config htmdoc.config.json

localizedText.zh-CN: 配置模式非空out-dir和sources-content-policy覆盖原值，no-doc-source-map可关闭地图。
localizedText.en: In config mode nonempty out-dir and sources-content-policy override configuration, and no-doc-source-map can disable maps.

localizedText.zh-CN: kind、workspace-root和位置输入仅用于直接模式；配置模式忽略。
localizedText.en: kind, workspace-root and positional inputs apply only to direct mode and are ignored in config mode.

localizedText.zh-CN: 配置路径相对调用目录，配置工作区相对配置目录；直接工作区相对调用目录，输出相对工作区。
localizedText.en: Config paths use cwd and configured workspaces use the config directory; direct workspaces use cwd and output uses the workspace.

localizedText.zh-CN: 构建创建目录并写工件，partial或failed可能保留成功输出；embed策略序列化获准的来源正文。
localizedText.en: Builds create directories and artifacts; partial or failed results may retain successful output, and embed serializes authorized source bodies.

localizedText.zh-CN: Node严格解析先于help，未知或缺值返回1；重复带值选项取末值，--后是位置输入。
localizedText.en: Node strict parsing precedes help; unknown switches or missing values exit 1. Repeated value options use the last value, and tokens after -- are positional.

localizedText.zh-CN: 评估显式HTML编写交接元数据
localizedText.en: Evaluate explicit HTML authoring handoff metadata

localizedText.zh-CN: 读取明确选定的元数据，纯评估生成accepted/refused交接报告。
localizedText.en: Read explicitly selected metadata and purely evaluate an accepted/refused handoff report.

localizedText.zh-CN: 显示工件契约0.1.0-draft；安装包为独立版本身份。
localizedText.en: Displays artifact contract 0.1.0-draft; package version is independent.

localizedText.zh-CN: 路径相对调用目录且受safe-relative检查；输出文件由调用者显式选择。
localizedText.en: Paths are cwd-relative and checked as safe-relative; callers select output explicitly.

localizedText.zh-CN: 运行读取所选元数据并可写所选结果文件；帮助不读取工作区。
localizedText.en: Runs read selected metadata and may write the selected result file; help does not inspect the workspace.

localizedText.zh-CN: Node严格解析先于help，拒绝位置输入。评估执行要求input，help/version提前返回。重复带值选项取末值。
localizedText.en: Node strict parsing precedes help and rejects positionals. Evaluation requires input, while help/version return early. Repeated value options use the last value.

localizedText.zh-CN: 省略或空out将报告写stdout；非空out写所选路径，已有父目录由调用者准备。
localizedText.en: Omitted or empty out writes the report to stdout; nonempty out writes the selected path, whose parent directory is prepared by the caller.
